errors.text_span: 组内左侧带有向右上倾斜斜线纹理的白色柱子代表“本文方法”，右侧带有向右下倾斜斜线纹理的灰色柱子代表“基线模型”
errors.evidence: Description reverses the visual attributes for the two series. The lighter (white) bars represent '本文方法' (this paper's method), and the darker (gray) bars represent '基线模型' (baseline model). The description incorrectly assigns the lighter bars to the left and darker bars to the right within each group.

errors.text_span: 在“近”类别中“本文方法”的柱子为全图最长，近似值为59.3%
errors.evidence: The description overestimates the value for '本文方法' in the '近' category. The figure shows it is approximately 59%, not 59.3%.

errors.text_span: 在“中”类别中，“本文方法”约为59.2%
errors.evidence: The description overestimates the value for '本文方法' in the '中' category. The figure shows it is slightly above 59%, closer to 59.1%, not 59.2%.

errors.text_span: 在“远”类别中，“本文方法”约为58.9%
errors.evidence: The description underestimates the value for '本文方法' in the '远' category. The figure shows it is approximately 59%, not 58.9%.
The description does not explicitly mention the legend's position in the upper right corner.

errors.evidence: The description introduces an interpretation ('自然逻辑顺序') not explicitly supported by the figure or atoms. The reference only states the categories are ordered as '近'、'中'、'远'.

errors.text_span: 垂直坐标轴为数值轴，标签为“F1 (%)”，采用线性缩放，数值范围从52到62，均匀刻度间隔为2，单位为百分比。
errors.evidence: The description is overly detailed in explaining the y-axis scale and units, which is redundant since the axis label 'F1 (%)' already implies percentage units.

errors.evidence: The sentence is overly long and repetitive, making it harder to follow. The phrase '在具体数值上' is also awkwardly placed.
